# Resolve species names

Resolve species in all datasets to GBIF accepted names using the package taxize:

## Species in sensitivity data

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(slopes_all_species$Species) # 187
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
spp1 <- slopes_all_species$Species[1:50]
spp2 <- slopes_all_species$Species[51:100]
spp3 <- slopes_all_species$Species[101:150]
spp4 <- slopes_all_species$Species[151:187]

# Getting current canonical names
resolved_1 <- gna_verifier(spp1, data_sources = 11) # 11 = GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
resolved_2 <- gna_verifier(spp2, data_sources = 11)
resolved_3 <- gna_verifier(spp3, data_sources = 11)
resolved_4 <- gna_verifier(spp4, data_sources = 11)

# Combining all of the names
all_resolved <- rbind(resolved_1, resolved_2, resolved_3, resolved_4)

# Add to sp_list
slopes_all_species_resolved <- slopes_all_species %>%
  cbind(., all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull) %>%
  rename(name_res = `all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull`)
slopes_all_resolved <- slopes_all %>%
  left_join(slopes_all_species_resolved)
```

## Species in  Red List data

Resolve species (accepted_taxon_name) to GBIF accepted names:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(unique(redlist$accepted_taxon_name)) # 36710
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
# Chunk the names into groups of <= 50
chunk_size <- 50
chunks <- split(unique(redlist$accepted_taxon_name), 
                ceiling(seq_along(unique(redlist$accepted_taxon_name)) / 
                          chunk_size))

# Helper to resolve one chunk using GBIF Backbone (data_sources = 11)
resolve_chunk_tbl <- function(x) {
  gna_verifier(
    names = x,
    data_sources = 11,       # GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
    all_matches = FALSE,     # best match only
    output_type = "table"
  )
}

# Process chunks with progress messages
resolved_tbl <- tryCatch(
  {
    imap_dfr(
      chunks,
      function(chunk, i) {

        message(
          sprintf(
            "Processing chunk %s of %s (%.1f%%)",
            i,
            length(chunks),
            100 * as.numeric(i) / length(chunks)
          )
        )

        resolve_chunk_tbl(chunk)
      }
    )
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("Error: ", e$message)
    NULL
  }
)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
resolved_tbl2 <- resolved_tbl %>%
  rename(
    rl_name_clean = submittedName,           
    name_res = currentCanonicalFull
  ) %>%
  # If duplicates exist in resolved_tbl (same submitted name multiple times),
  # keep the first/best one:
  distinct(rl_name_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

redlist_with_clean <- redlist %>%
  mutate(
    rl_name_raw   = accepted_taxon_name,
    rl_name_clean = str_squish(rl_name_raw)
  )

# Left-join: keep ALL rows from redlist
redlist_resolved <- redlist_with_clean %>%
  left_join(resolved_tbl2 %>%
              dplyr::select(rl_name_clean, name_res), 
            by = "rl_name_clean")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(unique(ellenberg$Art)) # 2791
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
# Chunk the names into groups of <= 50
chunks <- split(unique(ellenberg$Art), 
                ceiling(seq_along(unique(ellenberg$Art)) /

```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
resolved_tbl_list <- vector("list", length(chunks))
for (i in seq_along(chunks)) {
  cat("Resolving chunk", i, "of", length(chunks), 
      " (n =", length(chunks[[i]]), ")\n")
  res <- try(resolve_chunk_tbl(chunks[[i]]), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    cat("Chunk", i, "failed with:\n", attr(res, "condition")$message, "\n")
    break
  }
  resolved_tbl_list[[i]] <- res
}
resolved_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(resolved_tbl_list)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
resolved_tbl2 <- resolved_tbl %>%
  rename(
    ellenberg_name_clean = submittedName,           
    name_res = currentCanonicalFull
  ) %>%

  # keep the first/best one:
  distinct(ellenberg_name_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

ellenberg_with_clean <- ellenberg %>%

    ellenberg_name_raw   = Art,
    ellenberg_name_clean = str_squish(ellenberg_name_raw)

# Left-join: keep ALL rows from ellenberg

  left_join(resolved_tbl2 %>%
              dplyr::select(ellenberg_name_clean, name_res),
```

# Create occurrence matrix

Occurrence matrices are created using the package rgbif. 

## Get countries form RL

Get vector of ISO3 codes for European countries.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_europe <- redlist %>%
  mutate(
    continent = countrycode(
      ISO3_Code,
      origin = "iso3c",
      destination = "continent",
      custom_match = c("KOS" = "Europe")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(continent == "Europe")

ISO3_Codes <- redlist_europe %>%
  distinct(ISO3_Code) %>%
  pull(ISO3_Code)
```

## Build occurrence matrix

Build the species × country occurrence matrix with rgbif.

Settings:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
options(timeout = 180)                      # allow slower responses
options(future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")     # silence RNG warning when seed is set

workers <- 4
future::plan(multisession, workers = workers)
```

Helper functions:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

retry <- function(expr_fun, tries = 3L, base_wait = 0.7) {

  for (i in seq_len(tries)) {

    out <- try(expr_fun(), silent = TRUE)

    if (!inherits(out, "try-error")) {
      return(out)
    }

    Sys.sleep(base_wait * (2^(i - 1)))
  }

  out
}
```

Query GBIF once per species:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
get_species_country_counts <- function(sp) {

  require(rgbif)
  require(dplyr)
  require(tibble)

  res <- retry(
    function() {

      rgbif::occ_search(
        scientificName = sp,
        limit = 0,
        facet = "country",
        facetLimit = 300
      )

    }
  )

  if (inherits(res, "try-error") ||
      is.null(res$facets) ||
      length(res$facets) == 0) {

    return(
      tibble(
        species = sp,
        iso2 = character(),
        count = integer(),
        status = character()
      )
    )
  }

  country_tbl <- res$facets$country

  if (is.null(country_tbl) || nrow(country_tbl) == 0) {

    return(
      tibble(
        species = sp,
        iso2 = character(),
        count = integer(),
        status = character()
      )
    )
  }

  tibble(
    species = sp,
    iso2 = country_tbl$name,
    count = country_tbl$count,
    status = "ok"
  )
}
```

Parallel querying:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Get species vector
sp_vec <- unique(slopes_all_species_resolved$name_res)

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "GBIF species [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)",
  total = length(sp_vec),
  clear = FALSE
)

results_list <- future_map(
  sp_vec,
  function(sp) {

    out <- get_species_country_counts(sp)

    pb$tick()

    out

  },
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)

results <- bind_rows(results_list)
```

Convert ISO2 to ISO3. GBIF returns country codes as ISO2.Keep Kosovo, discard unknown countries. Keep only countries in Europe.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(
      iso2,
      origin = "iso2c",
      destination = "iso3c",
      custom_match = c(
        XK = "XKX",  # Kosovo
        ZZ = NA      # Unknown country
      )
    ),
    continent = countrycode(
      iso3,
      origin = "iso3c",
      destination = "continent",
      custom_match = c(
        XKX = "Europe",
        # Problematic countries not in Europe
        ATF = NA,
        HMD = NA,
        IOT = NA,
        SGS = NA,
        UMI = NA
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(continent == "Europe")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(
      iso2,
      origin = "iso2c",
      destination = "iso3c",
      custom_match = c(
        XK = "XKX",  # Kosovo
        ZZ = NA      # Unknown country
      )
    )
  )
```

Build complete species × country matrix:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
occurrence_matrix <- results %>%
  dplyr::select(species, iso3, count) %>%
  group_by(species, iso3) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(
    species = sp_vec,
    iso3 = ISO3_Codes,
    fill = list(count = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = iso3,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

Presence/Absence matrix:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
occ_matrix_pa <- results %>%
  mutate(presence = 1L) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, iso3, presence) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  complete(
    species = sp_vec,
    iso3 = ISO3_Codes,
    fill = list(presence = 0L)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = iso3,
    values_from = presence,
    values_fill = 0L
  ) %>%
  # Keep only countries from Red list in occurrence matrix
  dplyr::select(species, any_of(redlist_europe$ISO3_Code))
```

# Matching Phenobs - Red List data

Use the RL from all available countries!

Try to match the full PhenObs spp list with the RL to see how many species are there in each category for each country.

## Join RL and spp list in sensitivity data from PhenObs

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Change iso3 code for Kosovo
redlist_resolved <- redlist_resolved %>%
  mutate(ISO3_Code = ifelse(ISO3_Code == "KOS", "XKX", ISO3_Code))

redlist_phenobs <- tibble(slopes_all_species_resolved %>% 
                            dplyr::select(name_res)) %>%
  left_join(redlist_resolved) %>%
  # Keep columns that I think I will use
  dplyr::select(name_res, Redlist_cat, status, Country, Publ_year, ISO3_Code) %>%
  # Remove those with status == NA (not present in any red list)
  filter(!is.na(status))
redlist_phenobs
```

## Data prep RL

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Order from most severe -> least severe
severity_order <- c(
  "EX", "EW", "REW", "RE",
  "PEX", "PE",
  "CR", "EN", "VU", "R", "threatened",
  "NT", "LC",
  "DD", "NE", "WL"
)

# # Remove info from Russia!
# redlist_phenobs <- redlist_phenobs %>%
#   filter(ISO3_Code != "RUS")

redlist_phenobs_final <- redlist_phenobs %>%
  
  group_by(name_res, ISO3_Code) %>%
  
  slice({

    # Case 1: all publication years are NA (e.g. Russia)
    if (all(is.na(Publ_year))) {

      # Majority status
      threat_counts <- table(status)
      max_count <- max(threat_counts)

      winning_threats <- names(threat_counts)[
        threat_counts == max_count
      ]

      # No tie -> keep the most severe RL category
      # within the winning Threat
      if (length(winning_threats) == 1) {

        candidate_rows <- which(
          status == winning_threats
        )

      } else {

        # Tie -> consider all tied Threat groups
        candidate_rows <- which(
          status %in% winning_threats
        )
      }

      candidate_rows[
        which.min(
          match(
            Redlist_cat[candidate_rows],
            severity_order
          )
        )
      ]

    } else {

      # Case 2: publication years available

      latest_year <- max(Publ_year, na.rm = TRUE)

      latest_rows <- which(
        Publ_year == latest_year
      )

      # ALWAYS choose the most severe RL category
      # among records from the latest year

      latest_rows[
        which.min(
          match(
            Redlist_cat[latest_rows],
            severity_order
          )
        )
      ]
    }

  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Verify that there is only one record per species and country:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final %>% group_by(name_res, ISO3_Code) %>% filter(n() > 1)
```

Set those where status is not_evaluated_dd as not_threatened:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final <- redlist_phenobs_final %>%
   mutate(status = case_when(status == "not_evaluated_dd" ~ "not_threatened",
                             TRUE ~ status))
```

# Join occurrence data and Red List data 

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- 
  # Here, all 187 species are included
  occ_matrix_pa %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:42), names_to = "iso3", values_to = "occurrence") %>%
  # Here, only the species included in red lists in ANY country (i.e. 145 spp)
  # are included
  left_join(redlist_phenobs_final, by = c("species" = "name_res",
                                        "iso3" = "ISO3_Code")) %>%
  # Remove unneded columns
  dplyr::select(-Country, -Publ_year) %>%
  # Rename
  rename(country = iso3, threat = status) %>%
  # Order columns
  dplyr::select(species, country, occurrence, Redlist_cat, threat) %>%
  # Set those where threat is NA as not_threatened
  mutate(threat = case_when(
    is.na(threat) ~ "not_threatened",
    TRUE ~ threat
  ))
```

Change occurrence from 1 to 0 when threat == "extinct" (so we believe that RL data is correct, although checking in GBIF, records of these spp in these countries are found recently in some cases).

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  mutate(
    occurrence = case_when(
      threat == "extinct" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ occurrence
    )
  )
```

# Calculate measures of endangerment

Proportion of countries where the species is endangered, and proportion of range where species is endangered.
Also, country_threat_index and range_threat_index (include severity of threat).

Add info on country areas:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

countries_area <- world %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(8857) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))/1e6) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    country = iso_a3,
    area_km2
  )

extra_codes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~country, ~country_ref,
  "FRA", "France",
  "NOR", "Norway",
  "GLP", "Guadeloupe",
  "MTQ", "Martinique",
  "MYT", "Mayotte",
  "REU", "Reunion",
  "GUF", "French Guiana",
  "GIB", "Gibraltar",
  "SJM", "Svalbard and Jan Mayen",
  "TKL", "Tokelau",
  "UMI", "United States Minor Outlying Islands"
)

extra_area <- extra_codes %>%
  left_join(
    world %>%
      dplyr::select(admin, geometry),
    by = c("country_ref" = "admin")
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(8857) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))/1e6) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(country, area_km2)

countries_area <- bind_rows(countries_area, extra_area)

countries_area <- countries_area %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      country = c("KOS", "XKX"),
      area_km2 = 10887
    )
  )

redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  left_join(countries_area) %>%
  filter(country != "NA")
```

Define threat scores:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
perc_endangerment <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  mutate(
    threat_score = case_when(
      Redlist_cat == "VU" ~ 2,
      Redlist_cat == "EN" ~ 3,
      Redlist_cat == "CR" ~ 4,
      Redlist_cat %in% c("EX", "EW", "PEX", "RE", "REW") ~ 4,
      Redlist_cat == "threatened" ~ 3, # Assign midpoint to those without info on RL category
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(occurrence > 0) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_countries = n_distinct(country),

    threatened_countries =
      sum(threat == "threatened"),

    perc_endangerment =
      100 * threatened_countries / total_countries,

    total_area = sum(area_km2),

    threatened_area =
      sum(area_km2[threat == "threatened"]),

    perc_endangered_range =
      100 * threatened_area / total_area,

    country_threat_index =
      sum(threat_score, na.rm = TRUE) /
      (4 * total_countries),

    range_threat_index =
      sum(area_km2 * threat_score, na.rm = TRUE) /
      (4 * total_area),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_endangerment = perc_endangerment / 100,
    prop_endangered_range = perc_endangered_range / 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(species)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hist(perc_endangerment$prop_endangerment)
hist(perc_endangerment$prop_endangered_range)
hist(perc_endangerment$country_threat_index)
hist(perc_endangerment$range_threat_index)
```

# Prepare datasets for models

## Sensitivity + % endangerment

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sens_per_endanger <- perc_endangerment %>% 
  left_join(
    slopes_all_resolved %>% 
      dplyr::select(name_res, starts_with("mean_"), starts_with("slope_var"),
             starts_with("sens_01_")),
    by = c("species" = "name_res"),
    )
sens_per_endanger %>% filter(is.na(perc_endangerment)) %>% nrow()
sens_per_endanger %>% filter(is.na(mean_slope_FlOn)) %>% nrow() # 16 spp
sens_per_endanger %>% filter(is.na(mean_slope_GSL)) %>% nrow() # 33 spp
```

## Sensitivity + % endangerment + stress

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sens_per_endanger_stress <- sens_per_endanger %>%
  left_join(stress_resolved, by = c("species" = "name_res")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Species)
```

## Sensitivity + % endangerment + Ellenberg tendency of change

Deal with non-numeric values in indicator values

Columns OEK_L - OEK_S and HAEUF_AE_change

```{r}
ellenberg <- ellenberg %>%
  mutate(across(OEK_L:OEK_S, ~ parse_number(.)))
```

Join with sens_per_endanger:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sens_per_endanger_stress_ell <- sens_per_endanger_stress %>%
  left_join(ellenberg_resolved %>%
              dplyr::select(name_res, HAEUF_AE_change) %>%
              rename(change = HAEUF_AE_change) %>%
              group_by(name_res) %>%
              # For duplicates, get the mean
              summarise(change = as.integer(mean(change, na.rm = TRUE)),
                        .groups = "drop"), 
            by = c("species" = "name_res"))
```

# Models endangerment ~ sensitivity 

Filtering slope_var < 50 - clearer patterns.

Added prediction plots only for models with any significant effects.

## Define sensitivity sign

```{r}
sens_endanger <- sens_endanger %>%
  mutate(sens_sign = case_when(
    mean_slope < 0 ~ "negative",
    mean_slope > 0 ~ "positive",
    is.na(mean_slope) ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ "zero"
  ))
```

## Rename GSL to GSDur

```{r}
sens_endanger <- sens_endanger %>%
  mutate(stage = ifelse(stage == "GSL", "GSDur", stage))
```

## Fit models

```{r}
mod_prop_threat_countries <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_nest(stage, sens_sign) %>%
  mutate(
    model_name = paste(stage, sens_sign, sep = "_"),
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ glmmTMB(
        cbind(
          threatened_countries,
          total_countries - threatened_countries
        ) ~ mean_slope,
        data = .x,
        family = betabinomial()
      )
    )
  )

mod_country_threat_ix <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_nest(stage, sens_sign) %>%
  mutate(
    model_name = paste(stage, sens_sign, sep = "_"),
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ glmmTMB(
        country_threat_index ~ mean_slope,
        data = .x,
        family = beta_family(),
        ziformula = ~ .
      )
    )
  )

mod_prop_threat_range <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_nest(stage, sens_sign) %>%
  mutate(
    model_name = paste(stage, sens_sign, sep = "_"),
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ glmmTMB(
        prop_endangered_range ~ mean_slope,
        data = .x,
        family = beta_family(),
        ziformula = ~ .
      )
    )
  )

mod_range_threat_ix <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_nest(stage, sens_sign) %>%
  mutate(
    model_name = paste(stage, sens_sign, sep = "_"),
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ glmmTMB(
        range_threat_index ~ mean_slope,
        data = .x,
        family = beta_family(),
        ziformula = ~ .
      )
    )
  )

mod_prop_threat_countries %>% 
  transmute(stage, sens_sign, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.05)
mod_country_threat_ix %>% 
  transmute(stage, sens_sign, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.05)
mod_prop_threat_range %>% 
  transmute(stage, sens_sign, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.05)
mod_range_threat_ix %>% 
  transmute(stage, sens_sign, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.05)
```

## Model tables

```{r}
tab1 <- mod_prop_threat_countries %>%
  mutate(results = map(model, broom.mixed::tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>%
  filter(term == "mean_slope") %>%
  transmute(Sensitivity = stage,
            Sign = ifelse(sens_sign == "negative", "-", "+"),
            `Estimate` = round(estimate, 3),
            SE = round(std.error, 3),
            `p-value` = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  arrange(factor(
    Sensitivity,
    levels = c("LeafUnf", "FlOn", "FlPeak", "FrOn", "SensOn", "FlDur", 
               "GSDur")),
    factor(Sign, levels = c("-", "+"))
    ) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  merge_v(j = "Sensitivity") %>%
  valign(j = "Sensitivity", valign = "center") %>%
  bold(j = "p-value", i = ~ `p-value` < 0.05, bold = TRUE) %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  autofit()
```

```{r}
tab2 <- mod_country_threat_ix %>%
  mutate(results = map(model, broom.mixed::tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>%
  filter(term == "mean_slope") %>%
  mutate(Component = recode(component, cond = "Conditional", 
                            conditional = "Conditional", zi = "Zero-inflated",
                            zero_inflated = "Zero-inflated"),
         Sign = ifelse(sens_sign == "negative", "-", "+")) %>%
  transmute( Sensitivity = stage, Sign, Component, 
             Estimate = round(estimate, 3), SE = round(std.error, 3),
             `p-value` = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Component, 
              values_from = c(Estimate, SE, `p-value`)) %>%
  select(Sensitivity, Sign, Estimate_Zero.inflated = `Estimate_Zero-inflated`,
         SE_Zero.inflated = `SE_Zero-inflated`, 
         p_Zero.inflated = `p-value_Zero-inflated`, Estimate_Conditional,
         SE_Conditional, p_Conditional = `p-value_Conditional`) %>%
  arrange(factor(Sensitivity,
                 levels = c("LeafUnf", "FlOn", "FlPeak", "FrOn", "SensOn",
                            "FlDur", "GSDur")),
          factor(Sign, levels = c("-", "+"))) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  merge_v(j = "Sensitivity") %>%
  valign(j = "Sensitivity", valign = "center") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "", "Zero-inflated", "Conditional"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 1, 3, 3)) %>%
  align(i = 1, part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  set_header_labels(Sensitivity = "Sensitivity", Sign = "Sign",
                    Estimate_Zero.inflated = "Est.", SE_Zero.inflated = "SE",
                    p_Zero.inflated = "p-value", Estimate_Conditional = "Est.",
                    SE_Conditional = "SE", p_Conditional = "p-value") %>%
  bold(j = "p_Zero.inflated", i = ~ p_Zero.inflated < 0.05, bold = TRUE) %>%
  bold(j = "p_Conditional", i = ~ p_Conditional < 0.05, bold = TRUE) %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  autofit()
```

## Figures

### Fig. 1: Proportion of threatened countries

```{r}
fig1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(
      mod_prop_threat_countries %>%
        filter(stage == "FlOn" & sens_sign == "negative") %>% 
        pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
        ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]")),
      aes(x = x, y = predicted, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      alpha = 0.25, fill = "#0072B2") +
    geom_line(data = data.frame(
      mod_prop_threat_countries %>% 
        filter(stage == "FlOn" & sens_sign == "negative") %>% 
        pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
        ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]")
      ),
      aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = 
               sens_endanger %>% 
               filter(slope_var < 50 & stage == "FlOn"),
             aes(x = mean_slope, y = prop_endangerment, color = sens_sign), 
             size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(negative = "#0072B2", positive = "#D55E00")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Sensitivity of FlOn") +
  ylab("Proportion of threatened countries")
fig1
```

### Fig. 2: Probability of species endangerment

```{r}
fig2 <- ggplot() +
  # Negative
  geom_ribbon( data = data.frame(
    mod_country_threat_ix  %>% 
      filter(stage == "FlPeak" & sens_sign == "negative") %>% 
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob")
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = 1 - predicted, ymin = 1 - conf.low, ymax = 1 - conf.high), 
    alpha = 0.25, fill = "#0072B2") +
  geom_line( data = data.frame(
    mod_country_threat_ix  %>%
      filter(stage == "FlPeak" & sens_sign == "negative") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob")
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = 1 - predicted), color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.75) +
  # Positive
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(
    mod_country_threat_ix %>% 
      filter(stage == "FlPeak" & sens_sign == "positive") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob")),
    aes(x = x, y = 1 - predicted, ymin = 1-conf.low, ymax = 1-conf.high),
    alpha = 0.25, fill = "#D55E00") +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(
    mod_country_threat_ix %>% 
      filter(stage == "FlPeak" & sens_sign == "positive") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob")),
    aes(x = x, y = 1 - predicted), color = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.75) +
  # Points
  geom_jitter(data = sens_endanger %>%
               filter(slope_var < 50 & stage == "FlPeak") %>%
               mutate(y_01 = ifelse(country_threat_index == 0, 0, 1)),
             aes(x = mean_slope, y = y_01, color = sens_sign), 
             alpha = 0.5, size = 1, width = 0.02, height = 0.02) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(negative = "#0072B2", positive = "#D55E00")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Sensitivity of FlPeak") +
  ylab("Prob. of a species being threatened anywhere")
```

```{r}
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "fixed")),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_jitter(data = sens_endanger %>%
               filter(slope_var < 50 & stage == "FrOn"),
             aes(x = mean_slope, y = range_threat_index, color = sens_sign), 
             size = 1, alpha = 0.5, width = 0.02, height = 0.02) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(negative = "#0072B2", positive = "#D55E00")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Sensitivity of FrOn") +
  ylab("Range threat index")
fig5b <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(
    mod_range_threat_ix %>% 
      filter(stage == "FlDur" & sens_sign == "negative") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "fixed")),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.25, fill = "#0072B2") +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(
    mod_range_threat_ix %>% 
      filter(stage == "FlDur" & sens_sign == "negative") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "fixed")),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_jitter(data = sens_endanger %>%
               filter(slope_var < 50 & stage == "FlDur"),
             aes(x = mean_slope, y = range_threat_index, color = sens_sign), 
             size = 1, alpha = 0.5, width = 0.02, height = 0.02) +
```

# OLD:  Models endangerment ~ sensitivity 

Filtering slope_var < 50 - clearer patterns.

Added prediction plots only for models with any significant effects.

## Mean slopes

### LeafUnf, FLOn, FlPeak, FrOn, SensOn

#### Negative slopes only

```{r}
mod_sens_neg <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50 & mean_slope < 0) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(cbind(threatened_countries,
                                       total_countries - threatened_countries) ~
                                   mean_slope,
                                 data = .x, family = betabinomial())))
mod_sens_neg_range <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50 & mean_slope < 0) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(prop_endangered_range ~ mean_slope,
                                 data = .x, family = beta_family(), 
                                 ziformula=~.)))
mod_sens_neg_country_threat_ix <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50 & mean_slope < 0) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(country_threat_index ~ mean_slope,
                                 data = .x, family = beta_family(), 
                                 ziformula=~.)))
mod_sens_neg_range_threat_ix <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50 & mean_slope < 0) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(range_threat_index ~ mean_slope,
                                 data = .x, family = beta_family(), 
                                 ziformula=~.)))

mod_sens_neg %>% transmute(stage, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.1)
mod_sens_neg_range %>% transmute(stage, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.1)
mod_sens_neg_country_threat_ix %>% transmute(stage, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.1)
mod_sens_neg_range_threat_ix %>% transmute(stage, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.1)
```

```{r}
mod_sens_neg %>% filter(stage == "FlOn") %>% pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
  ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]") %>% plot() # p = 0.027
mod_sens_neg_range %>% filter(stage == "FlPeak") %>% pull(model) %>% 
  .[[1]] %>%
  ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob") %>% plot() # p = 0.044
mod_sens_neg_country_threat_ix  %>% filter(stage == "FlOn") %>% pull(model) %>% 
  .[[1]] %>%
  ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "fixed") %>% plot() # p < 0.001
mod_sens_neg_country_threat_ix  %>% filter(stage == "FlPeak") %>% 
  pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
  ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob") %>% plot() # p = 0.044
mod_sens_neg_range_threat_ix  %>% filter(stage == "FlPeak") %>% pull(model) %>% 
  .[[1]] %>%
  ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob") %>% plot() # p = 0.044 # zi part equal to previous one!
```

```{r}
desired_order <- c("LeafUnf", "FlOn", "FlPeak", "FrOn", "SensOn")

]
mods2 <- mod_sens_neg_range$model[
  match(desired_order, mod_sens_neg_range$stage)
]

]
mods4 <- mod_sens_neg_range_threat_ix$model[

]

names(mods2) <- desired_order
names(mods3) <- desired_order
names(mods4) <- desired_order

tab1 <- modelsummary(mods1, shape = model ~ term + statistic, output = "flextable", 
                     coef_omit = "Intercept", fmt = 3,
                     estimate = c("Estimate" = "{estimate}"),
                     gof_omit = "AIC|BIC|RMSE|R2|Log.Lik|ICC|Num.Obs",
                     statistic = c("SE" = "{std.error}", "p-value" = "{p.value}"),
                     coef_rename = c(mean_slope = ""))
tab1 <- hline_top(tab1, border = fp_border(color = "white", width = 0),
                  part = "header") |> 
  # Bold significant p-values
  bold(j = "p-value", i = ~ `p-value` < 0.05, bold = TRUE) |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")


tab2 <- modelsummary(mods2, shape = model + component ~ term + statistic,
```

```{r}
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob")),
    aes(x = x, y = 1 - predicted, ymin = 1-conf.low, ymax = 1-conf.high),
    alpha = 0.25, fill = "#D55E00") +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(
    mod_sens_pos_country_threat_ix %>% filter(stage == "FlPeak") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "zi_prob")),
    aes(x = x, y = 1 - predicted), color = "#D55E00", linewidth = 1) +
  # Points
  geom_jitter(data = sens_endanger %>%
               filter(slope_var < 50 & stage == "FlPeak") %>%
                mutate(neg_pos = factor(ifelse(mean_slope< 0, "neg", "pos"))) %>%
               mutate(y_01 = ifelse(country_threat_index == 0, 0, 1)),
             aes(x = mean_slope, y = y_01, color = neg_pos), 
             alpha = 0.6, width = 0.02, height = 0.02) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(neg = "#0072B2", pos = "#D55E00")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Sensitivity of flowering peak") +
  ylab("Country threat index")

fig3c <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = data.frame(
    mod_sens_pos_country_threat_ix %>% filter(stage == "FlPeak") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "fixed")),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.25, fill = "#D55E00") +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(
    mod_sens_pos_country_threat_ix %>% filter(stage == "FlPeak") %>%
      pull(model) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      ggpredict(terms = "mean_slope [all]", type = "fixed")),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "#D55E00", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_jitter(data = sens_endanger %>%
```

### FlDur and GSL: all values

```{r}
# Models with quadratic term of slope
mod_sens_all_quad <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(cbind(threatened_countries,
                                       total_countries - threatened_countries) ~
                                   mean_slope + I(mean_slope^2),
                                 data = .x, family = betabinomial())))
mod_sens_all_range_quad <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(prop_endangered_range ~
                                   mean_slope + I(mean_slope^2),
                                 data = .x, family = beta_family(), 
                                 ziformula=~.)))
mod_sens_all_country_threat_ix_quad <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(country_threat_index ~
                                   mean_slope + I(mean_slope^2),
                                 data = .x, family = beta_family(), 
                                 ziformula=~.)))
mod_sens_all_range_threat_ix_quad <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_nest(stage) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, 
                       ~ glmmTMB(range_threat_index ~
                                   mean_slope + I(mean_slope^2),
                                 data = .x, family = beta_family(), 
                                 ziformula=~.)))

# Models without quadratic term of slope

mod_sens_all_quad %>% transmute(stage, results = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.1)
```

```{r}
tab9 <- modelsummary(mods9, shape = model ~ term + statistic, output = "flextable", 
                     coef_omit = "Intercept", fmt = 3,
                     estimate = c("Estimate" = "{estimate}"),
                     gof_omit = "AIC|BIC|RMSE|R2|Log.Lik|ICC|Num.Obs",
                     statistic = c("SE" = "{std.error}", "p-value" = "{p.value}"),
                     coef_rename = c(mean_slope = "Linear", "I(mean_slope^2)" = "Quadratic"))

                  part = "header") |> 
  # Bold significant p-values
  bold(j = "p-value", i = ~ `p-value` < 0.05, bold = TRUE) |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")


tab10 <- modelsummary(mods10, shape = model + component ~ term + statistic,
                     output = "flextable",  coef_omit = "Intercept", fmt = 3,

  hline_top(border = fp_border(color = "white", width = 0), part = "header") |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
```

# PCA

```{r}
pca_phen <- prcomp(sens_per_endanger %>% 
                     dplyr::select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>%
                     drop_na(), 
                   center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
```

```{r}
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_phen$x) %>%
  mutate(species = (sens_per_endanger %>%
                      dplyr::select(species, starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>%
                      drop_na())$species) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(abs(PC1) > quantile(abs(PC1), 0.95) |
                          abs(PC2) > quantile(abs(PC2), 0.95),
                        species, ""))
```

```{r}
# Variable loadings for arrows
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_phen$rotation) %>%
  mutate(variable = rownames(.)) %>%
  # Remove mean_slope from variable names
  mutate(variable = gsub("mean_slope_", "", variable))

ggplot(scores %>%
         left_join(
           sens_per_endanger %>% 
             dplyr::select(species, prop_endangerment)
           ), 
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, color = "steelblue"
             ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1*3, yend = PC2*3),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "darkred") +
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings,
                  aes(x = PC1*3, y = PC2*3, label = variable),
                  color = "red3", size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
```

```{r}
plot(pca_phen)
```

## Clustering

```{r}
dist_pcs <- dist(scores %>%
                   dplyr::select(PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4), 
                 method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_pcs, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
scores$cluster <- factor(cutree(hc, k = 3))
ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot with clusters

```{r}
ggplot(
  scores %>%
    left_join(
      sens_per_endanger %>% 
        dplyr::select(species, prop_endangerment),
      by = "species"
    ),
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 3, yend = PC2 * 3),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = PC1 * 4, y = PC2 * 4, label = variable),
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    nudge_x = 0.1* sign(loadings$PC1),
    nudge_y = 0.1 * sign(loadings$PC2),
    box.padding = 0.2,      # distance around text box
    point.padding = 0.2,    # distance from arrows/points
    max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  #stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.8))
```

# RDA effect of endangerment

## Endangered or not

```{r}
rda_trait_endanger <- rda(
  sens_per_endanger %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>% drop_na() ~ 
    (sens_per_endanger %>%
       mutate(endangerment = factor(
         ifelse(prop_endangerment == 0, 0, 1)))%>% drop_na())$endangerment,
  data = sens_per_endanger
  )
anova(rda_trait_endanger, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_trait_endanger, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
RsquareAdj(rda_trait_endanger)
```

## Proportion of endangerment

```{r}
rda_trait_endanger_prop <- rda(
  sens_per_endanger %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>% drop_na() ~ 
    (sens_per_endanger%>% drop_na())$prop_endangerment,
  data = sens_per_endanger
  )
anova(rda_trait_endanger_prop, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_trait_endanger_prop, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
RsquareAdj(rda_trait_endanger_prop)
```

# Knit document

```{r}
knit_docx(
  template_docx_file = here("docs", "PhenObs_cluster1_draft.docx"),
  knitted_docx_file = here("docs", "PhenObs_cluster1_draft_knitted.docx")
)

doc <- read_docx(
  here("docs", "PhenObs_cluster1_draft_knitted.docx")
)

tables <- list(
  TABLE_1_HERE = tab1,
  TABLE_2_HERE = tab2,
  TABLE_3_HERE = tab3,
  TABLE_4_HERE = tab4
)

for (ph in names(tables)) {

  doc <- cursor_begin(doc)
  doc <- cursor_reach(doc, ph)

  doc <- body_add_flextable(
    doc,
    value = tables[[ph]],
    pos = "on"
  )

}

print(
  doc,
  target = here("docs", "PhenObs_cluster1_draft_knitted_final.docx")
)
```
